visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three men are seated in a studio setting. The man in the foreground, with short black hair and a black t-shirt, smiles at the camera. Behind him, two men sit at a desk; one on the left wears a yellow cap and white tank top, while the one on the right wears glasses and a black t-shirt. On-screen graphics present two versions of the Apple logo. (2) The scene cuts as the men react to the challenge, with the man in the cap covering his eyes and laughing hysterically. The environment is a brightly lit studio with shelves in the background containing various items like a water bottle and a plastic sword. (3) The video proceeds through several more logo-guessing rounds including a mascot character and the Coca-Cola logo. The men use expressive hand gestures and point towards the screen while laughing. (4) The final rounds feature logos for Taiwanese National Health Insurance and TSMC. The lighting is bright and consistent throughout, and the editing is fast-paced with frequent cuts between the participants' reactions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voices enter with loud laughter and shouting. An upbeat, fast-tempo electronic BGM with a strong rhythmic pulse begins. A sharp 'whoosh' SFX signals the start of the challenge. (2) Rapid conversational interplay between three men. The BGM continues with high brightness and percussive synth textures. Digital 'ding' SFX are triggered during logo reveals. (3) Vocal intensity peaks with high arousal as the men scream and laugh at a funny logo. A comical meme sound effect (cat video style) briefly interrupts the vocal flow. (4) The speech rate remains fast as they rush through final guesses. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo until a final fade-out accompanied by a concluding jingle SFX.
